status: FIT-REVIEW PROTOTYPE — NOT RELEASED FOR PRINTING

switch_opening.status: Native v0.3 build and exported geometry verified; physical fit and finger access remain unverified
switch_opening.note: Measured barrel center from the panel edge and active face. Switch lies on negative Y, with X running rearward from the lens. Slot bounds conservatively sweep the barrel diameter through full tip travel; symmetric throw and a lever no thicker than the barrel are prototype assumptions.

assumptions: The 15.2 mm stack includes the solar panel and permanent components; the temporary protector is excluded.
Panel pocket and lens diameters use 0.20 mm total added clearance provisionally. Only the 1.40 mm axial lens groove is specified.
The panel has at least 0.50 mm of inactive border available for the retention lip. This must be checked before printing.
The 33.8 mm rear lens bore clears the tapered optic and LED PCB; the PCB/solder envelope must be measured.
Existing wires reach from the fixed module to the lens at this placement without tension.
Four outward-flexing side catches are prototypes. Their cyclic life and release force in PLA are unverified.
The enlarged nose requires slicer review of support and print orientation. No support-free claim is made.
Switch access uses 0.20 mm total barrel-diameter allowance plus the full 8.0 mm tip travel. This is a conservative access envelope, not a measured lever diameter at the wall.
Lever throw is treated as symmetric about the barrel axis, and the moving lever is assumed no thicker than its 5.6 mm barrel. Physical operation and finger access remain to be checked.
